additional_scope: 55 order panels for 49 records enlarged to central ±8 columns using unchanged 31-row arrays and recorded per-order scales; original full atlas inspected for all 115 records. Positive excess is clipped only for display; original raw, frozen side background and difference spatial curves are retained.
independence: Primary batch03 visual review and dispositions were not opened before this secondary result was saved. Reviewer knew the frozen plan, prior project context and root notice of mapping accounting. This is a separate AI-agent descriptive review, not blinded scientific validation or human review.
classification_policy: Provisional morphology only. Any covering-order mapping limitation or missing full cutout takes precedence as M. O requires observer-frame OI-compatible wavelength plus photon-like trace morphology; wavelength alone is insufficient. A requires clear charge-like morphology but cannot exclude an underlying photon contribution. Broad, ambiguous or mixed unresolved features remain U. No classifier, extraction or mapping threshold was changed.
display_policy: Central enlargements were selected after atlas viewing to clarify ambiguous/calibration-B-dominated displays. They are post hoc display-only crops of retained unchanged arrays, not threshold tuning or an independent test. Every exact pixel crop and color scale is recorded in secondary_enlarged/INDEX.json, reproducible by secondary_enlarged/render.py with its recorded selection.
cautions: V2E2-0099 contains a bright off-trace charge deposit plus weaker diffuse trace-centered excess; underlying spectral structure is not excluded (CENTRAL_02).
V2E2-0122 remains U: an oblique several-pixel enhancement overlaps the trace, with flat-topped/asymmetric native structure; charge contamination or a blend is plausible (CENTRAL_02).
V2E2-0230 has a clear compact order3 contaminant superposed on a broad feature shared with order4; A concerns the sharp component only (CENTRAL_08).
OI-compatible V2E2-0100,0168,0219,0221 have weak contrast, residual gradients or some spatial asymmetry; their O codes do not establish atmosphere as the physical source.
V2E2-0234 remains U despite noisy blue-order amplitude mismatch; central enlargement confirms a broad trace-centered patch in order3.
V2E2-0194 has photon-like enlarged morphology but retains M because its covering-order mapping is unsupported.
All32 exposures have STAR,WAVE fiber configuration; no independent sky-fiber confirmation is demonstrated.
No claim of a qualified laser, calibrated null result, sensitivity or global false-alarm probability.
